name: Compact List
tagline: A Dataverse view as a stacked list of records, for narrow spaces.

limitations: Search narrows the list. With Show search on, the control calls dataset.filtering.setFilter() and then refresh(), and the demo applies the expression to the whole fixture on that fetch, as a real view does on the server; the count and the filteredRecordCount output follow, and clearing the box brings every account back. The match ignores case, as Dataverse’s default collation does. The call log under the demo shows the rest of what the control does: the debounce, the expression and the paging reset.

Both paging modes work against the fixture. Every preset asks for eight records a page, so the 24 accounts make three pages: Comfortable and With a search box page with Previous and Next, and Compact, no labels adds eight at a time with Load more until all 24 are shown. What a real view adds is size: the page size is a request the platform may clamp, and a large view may not count its rows.

Clicking an item calls dataset.openDatasetItem(), which the harness logs as a mock call: there is no Dataverse behind this origin and no form to open. The openedRecordId output still updates, so the value a canvas app would react to is visible.

presets.name: Comfortable
presets.description: Three labelled detail lines under each account name, with a pager: eight to a page, so the 24 accounts make three.

presets.name: Compact, no labels
presets.description: Two unlabelled detail lines and tighter spacing — the shape for a narrow form section. Load more adds eight at a time.

presets.name: With a search box
presets.description: Show search on, matching anywhere in the account name. Type part of a name and the list narrows; the call log below shows the expression the control sent.
